name: s390_guarded_storage
synopsis: int syscall(SYS_s390_guarded_storage, int command, struct gs_cb *gs_cb);
description: The s390_guarded_storage() system call enables the use of the Guarded Storage Facility on s390 architecture for user-space processes. It provides commands to manage features like enabling guarded storage, marking memory regions, and handling events via specific instructions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Specifies the operation to perform, such as GS_ENABLE, GS_DISABLE, GS_SET_BC_CB, GS_CLEAR_BC_CB, or GS_BROADCAST.

parameters.name: gs_cb
parameters.description: Pointer to a guarded storage control block structure, used by commands like GS_SET_BC_CB; ignored by others.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: command was GS_SET_BC_CB and the copying of the guarded storage control block structure pointed by gs_cb has failed.
The value provided in the command argument was not valid.
command was one of GS_ENABLE or GS_SET_BC_CB, and the allocation of a new guarded storage control block has failed.
The guarded storage facility is not supported by the hardware.
